models.verification: bootstrap license record; pinned tree accessible, README web read failed

runner_status: protocol and inputs ready; existing bootstrap runner needs step5 adapter before these queries
legacy_runner_compatibility: Do not pass this pack directly to scripts/model_benchmark.py: no-gold queries would divide by zero
Apply identical scope before BM25 IDF/ranking and dense/reranker selection
Add Hit@1/MRR, scope/response cases, repeated timings and raw failures without overwriting bootstrap results

retrieval.unit: one existing fact summary per exact manual location; no query/gold in model input
retrieval.filter: same resolved model_id AND exact document_version for all three methods, before ranking
retrieval.unresolved_scope: missing requested version: request revision, do not substitute current revision
retrieval.foreign_scope: reject use of another model's evidence for the target model

bm25.tokenization: Unicode word regex, casefold; no new Korean morphological analyzer

retrieval.primary_metric: macro Hit@1 on the 11 questions with supported evidence

formulas.Hit@1: 1 if first ID is in gold, otherwise 0; failures count 0
formulas.Recall@3: distinct gold IDs in first 3 / number of gold IDs; failures count 0
formulas.MRR@3: 1 / first relevant rank when rank <=3, otherwise 0
formulas.model_mix_rate@3: foreign model IDs / returned IDs; empty=NA
formulas.version_mix_rate@3: wrong document version IDs / returned IDs; empty=NA

retrieval.no_gold_policy: 4 non-answerable/scope/input cases excluded from ranking average; response disposition and prohibited claims reviewed separately

latency.order: fixed shuffled query order shared across methods
latency.boundary: warm query embedding + structural filtering/ranking + optional reranking; cold download/load/index separate
latency.failure_policy: record every attempt; timeouts/failures retained, latency summary successful attempts only with failure_count

runtime.initial_device: same host CPU for all methods
runtime.gpu_track: separate run only after assigned GPU usage check; never compare CPU and GPU as same-condition latency

retrieval.truncation_policy: record actual tokenizer lengths; any truncation requires new protocol version and rerun of all methods

ocr.source: same hash-locked real text PDF pages; rendered image is not a newly collected scan
ocr.segmentation: manually located line/row crops; store page, pixel bbox, original raster dimensions and crop hash before running recognition
ocr.gold: short source-located exact excerpts for CER; numeric/unit/model-column field targets independently checked against page

metrics.CER: Levenshtein distance / gold chars after NFC and whitespace-collapse; report per aligned crop only
metrics.unit_accuracy: correct explicit units / target unit fields
metrics.model_column_accuracy: values bound to correct model/column / target fields

ocr.recognizer: korean_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec, CPU4threads, enable_mkldnn=False; existing recognition model only
ocr.whole_page_layout_status: not_in_this_initial_track; detector/layout model not selected; manual crop success is not whole-page OCR success
ocr.normalization: do not drop digits, decimal dots, units, minus signs or model codes; normalize × and x only in dimension tuple field scoring

decision_policy.mandatory: no foreign model/version contamination; conditional/unknown status preserved
decision_policy.accuracy: compare paired question results and failed cases; higher development Hit@1 alone is not independent superiority
decision_policy.speed: if accuracy ties prefer simpler/lower-latency baseline, with hardware/precision equal
decision_policy.release: PM reviews actual outputs, licensing/runtime and source links before method adoption and formal dependency/completion

coverage_limits: 15 authored development queries, not independent final evaluation
27 curated fact summaries, not full manuals; fridge has only 4 passages so Hit@1 is primary
one real manual revision per model; same-model old revision exclusion needs future real source
actual customer reviews=0; R13 customer inconvenience/review traceability not verified
OCR line/row crop track does not validate full-page detection or layout
existing bootstrap 6 queries/2 OCR results are historical, not scores for this pack
execution_preflight: resolve original source folder and verify all PDF/cache/source/output hashes
verify installed runtime + model weight revision/licenses; no automatic downloads in preparation
record CPU/RAM or authorized GPU current use, free space and process isolation
review development gold with PM; keep private independent evaluation untouched
use a new output directory; keep status not_executed until actual outputs exist
